commanders.name: Alexander the Great

skills.name: Shield of the King
skills.effect: Puts up a shield that absorbs damage for 4 seconds and at the same time puts up a smaller shield for the nearby friendly army for 2 seconds (the smaller shield does not benefit Alexander's own army).

skills.name: Lead the Charge
skills.effect: Troops are resistant to damage-reduction debuffs while on the map. Each normal attack has a 10% chance to deal additional damage to the target and to reduce the target's healing effects for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Frontline Commander
skills.effect: Increases infantry units' march speed and attack while on the map.

skills.name: Battle of Chaeronea
skills.effect: When troops are not shielded, attack is increased; while Alexander's shield is active the bonus is changed to defense instead (attack +40% unshielded / defense +30% shielded at level 5).

skills.name: Son of Amun
skills.effect: Enhanced Shield of the King: immediately puts up a shield that absorbs a large amount of damage (Damage Factor 1200) for 4 seconds and a second shield (Damage Factor 600) for 2 seconds for the nearby friendly army with the lowest percentage of troops remaining, plus a 30% damage modifier for 4 seconds: zoe-rok and heaven-guardian describe it as 'up to 3 nearby enemies take 30% increased damage', theriagames/zathong as '+30% damage dealt' (see conflicts).

talent_builds.notes: Build unico consigliato da riseofkingdomsguides: si ignora completamente l'albero Versatility. Allclash concorda (Infantry + Attack, evitare Versatility) e indica come priorita' Strong of Body, Fleet of Foot, Elite Soldiers, poi Effortless, Armored Joints e Martial Mastery. Touchscreengaming aggiunge Unyielding (danno da contrattacco).

pairings.note: Per allclash e touchscreengaming e' il pairing universale nei regni giovani (Alexander primario secondo touchscreengaming); riseofkingdomsguides invece lo mette secondario a Yi.
Sinergia fanteria; gli scudi di Alexander e Martel NON si sommano (allclash). Pagina Martel: Alexander come secondario, 'ultimate tank duo'.
Pagina Richard di riseofkingdomsguides: Richard primario + Alexander secondario 'strongest field duo'; allclash lo limita alle prime stagioni KvK.
Guan Yu primario; lo scudo attiva Lone Rider. Allclash lo consiglia soprattutto per Sunset Canyon.
Alternativa economica quando mancano legendari, genera molta rabbia (allclash).
Citato dalle pagine di Leonidas (riseofkingdomsguides, heaven-guardian).

ratings.comment: valued for shielding ability and infantry synergy

commanders.skill_upgrade_order: Maxare Shield of the King per prima (5111), poi 5511 → 5551 o expertise (touchscreengaming); allclash indica come sweetspot 5515; hokbuild 5-5-1-1. Heaven-guardian (2026-08-06): 5-5 → 5-5-5-1 → expertise se serve.
commanders.recommended_equipment: hokbuild: Staff of the Lost, Expedition War Helm, Commander's Heavy Armor, Windswept Bracers, Greaves of the Exile, Windswept Boots. Touchscreengaming late game: Helm of the Conqueror, Hope Cloak, Hammer of the Sun and Moon (+ accessori Greatest Glory, Ring of Doom, Horn of Fury, Concealed Dagger). Allclash progression: Helm of Phoenix/Infantry Breastplate/Blessed Blade → Witch's Lineage/Hope Cloak/Gatekeeper's Shield → Gold Helm of Eternal Empire/Hope Cloak/Shield of Eternal Empire → Helm of the Conqueror/Hope Cloak/Hammer of Sun and Moon.
commanders.notes: Tank di fanteria con scudo e supporto; ottenibile dalla Wheel of Fortune dal giorno 200 del regno (o Card King). Solido per KvK 1-3, superato nella Season of Conquest. Usare solo fanteria (bonus velocita' della 3a skill). Ideale come secondario in campo aperto perche' non ha l'albero Defense. Anno di rilascio: un riassunto WebSearch indica giugno 2019 ma non e' stato possibile verificarlo su una pagina. 690 sculture per portare un legendario da sbloccato a 5-5-5-5 (expertise); 10 sculture specifiche in piu' per sbloccarlo (fonte heaven-guardian e riseofkingdomsguides, dato generico per tutti i legendari). Correzione: Battle of Chaeronea da' +40% attacco senza scudo e +30% difesa con scudo attivo (20/25/30/35/40 e 10/15/20/25/30 per livello; zoe-rok, heaven-guardian), non +30% fisso. Bluestacks (2022-07-04) conferma indipendentemente le 690 sculture per maxare un legendario.
